content:
Comedian Stavros Halkias hit ESPN’s “ManningCast” with a profane blast as his beloved Baltimore Ravens appeared to fumble away the game to the winless Los Angeles Chargers on Monday. (Watch the video below.)

Halkias, who has his own recent comedy special on Netflix, nearly jumped out of his purple velour-type warmup suit after Ravens receiver Zay Flowers got strip-tackled and lost the ball to LA.

Hosts Peyton and Eli Manning replayed the Baltimore native’s mouth-agape-head-grabbing shock on their ESPN2 show, prompting the obscene burst from Halkias.

“I can’t believe I agreed to do this bullshit,” he said. “This fucking sucks.”

After being admonished with some “OK, OKs” from the ex-quarterback brothers, Halkias said “Sorry, sorry” before the 2-minute warning was announced.

The Ravens lost star quarterback Lamar Jackson to a thumb injury on Nov. 1 and carried a four-game losing streak into Monday night.

Halkias, who recently starred in the Anthony Bourdain biopic “Tony,” might have figured out beforehand that his team’s circumstance was a recipe for disaster.
